brief:
Mariam Dagga, a Palestinian war correspondent killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza at age 33, has posthumously received the prestigious Rory Peck prize, The Guardian reported. She shares the award with two colleagues from the Associated Press for their coverage of the human cost of the war.

Dagga died while reporting from one of the world's most dangerous conflict zones. The Rory Peck prize honors journalists killed or injured covering wars and civil unrest.

title: Slain Gaza journalist wins Rory Peck prize posthumously
